## 1. Purpose and scope
This specification defines the functional and non-functional requirements to resolve an inconsistency in TinyDB document ID handling where `update()` and `remove()` methods silently perform no operation when passed string representation of document IDs (such as `doc_ids=['1']`), whereas `get()` successfully resolves string document IDs (S-01, S-02, S-05).

## 2. Actors
| ID | Actor | Basis | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| ACT-1 | Developer / Caller | STATED | S-01, S-02, S-04 |
| ACT-2 | TinyDB Table Engine | INFERRED | S-01, S-02, S-05 |

## 3. Constraints
| ID | Statement | Basis | Source | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CON-1 | TinyDB shall execute on Python 3.12 environment | STATED | S-06 | READY |
| CON-2 | The `update` and `remove` operations shall not raise exceptions when encountering non-matching or invalid doc_ids | STATED | S-04 | READY |

## 4. Functional requirements
| ID | Statement | Basis | Source | Priority | Gate | AC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | The `Table.update` method shall match and update existing documents when `doc_ids` contains string document IDs matching existing document IDs | STATED | S-02, S-05 | MUST | READY | AC-001-1, AC-001-2 |
| FR-002 | The `Table.remove` method shall match and remove existing documents when `doc_ids` contains string document IDs matching existing document IDs | STATED | S-02, S-05 | MUST | READY | AC-002-1, AC-002-2 |
| FR-003 | The `Table.update` and `Table.remove` methods shall return the list of matching document IDs when document IDs are supplied as strings | INFERRED | S-02, S-05 | MUST | READY | AC-003-1, AC-003-2 |
| FR-004 | The `Table.update` and `Table.remove` methods shall silently skip non-existent document IDs without crashing when `doc_ids` contains IDs (string or int) not present in the table | STATED | S-04 | MUST | READY | AC-004-1 |

## 5. Non-functional reqs
| ID | Statement | Basis | Source | Priority | Gate | AC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFR-001 | The ID matching logic in `update` and `remove` shall be consistent with the ID matching logic in `get` for both integer and string representations | STATED | S-05 | MUST | READY | AC-NFR-001-1 |

| AC-001-2 | FR-001 | Given a TinyDB table containing a document with string ID `'abc'`, when `table.update({'x': 2}, doc_ids=['abc'])` is called, then the document with ID `'abc'` has field `x` updated to `2` |

| AC-002-2 | FR-002 | Given a TinyDB table containing a document with string ID `'abc'`, when `table.remove(doc_ids=['abc'])` is called, then the document with ID `'abc'` is removed from the table |
